gaps.title: Post-acquisition expansion with no stated plan to keep monitoring consistent
gaps.detail: In 2023 Americold took a 49% stake specifically to expand RSA locally and connect it to Americold's global network -- meaning new facilities and markets beyond the current single Dubai site are coming. RSA's marketing already claims continuous monitoring and a real-time WMS today, but nothing describes how that gets replicated consistently as the network grows.
gaps.based_on: In 2023, Americold acquired a 49% minority stake in RSA Cold Chain... with immediate plans to expand locally, connect RSA to its global network, and pursue development opportunities across the Middle East and India.

gaps.title: Quality certifications are periodic audits, not real-time compliance evidence
gaps.detail: ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 are process/quality-management standards verified through periodic audits -- they don't generate real-time, audit-ready deviation records on their own. RSA's separate claim of 'continuous monitoring' doesn't describe automated compliance reporting tied to those certification requirements.
gaps.based_on: The facility holds ISO 9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001 certifications; RSA's own marketing claims an advanced WMS for real-time inventory visibility and continuous temperature monitoring.

pitch.angle: RSA Cold Chain already invests seriously in tech -- a real-time WMS, continuous monitoring, an API for live inventory -- and just brought on Americold as a 49% partner specifically to expand into new markets and connect to a global network. That's exactly the moment a fast-growing operator needs monitoring and compliance to scale with the network instead of being rebuilt site by site. GND's ThinxFresh wouldn't be introducing monitoring to RSA -- it'd be the layer that keeps every new site as consistent and audit-ready as the flagship Dubai facility, from day one.
pitch.opener: With Americold now backing your expansion into new markets, how are you planning to keep monitoring and compliance consistent as new sites come online -- same system everywhere, or rebuilt per facility?
